title: Sparse-WAM: Accelerating World Action Models via Action-Guided Sparse Imagination
abstract: arXiv:2609.38984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video models to improve generalization in robot control by jointly predicting future visual states and actions. This capability comes at a substantial inference cost, as dense future-frame tokens are repeatedly processed during denoising. Prior methods address this by token pruning that prioritizes visual fidelity to reduce denoising costs in video diffusion models. However, these methods do not use action relevance to determine which future-frame tokens to retain during joint denoising in WAMs. In this paper, we propose Sparse-WAM, a training-free framework for action-guided sparse imagination that selectively processes future-frame tokens to accelerate WAM inference. We observe substantial overlap in the spatial distribution of attention from action tokens to future-frame tokens (action-to-future attention) between consecutive denoising steps, despite continued updates to the future repr

translated_title: Sparse-WAM：通过动作引导的稀疏想象加速世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型（WAM）利用预训练视频模型，通过联合预测未来视觉状态和动作来提升机器人控制的泛化能力。然而这种能力伴随着高昂的推理成本，因为在去噪过程中需要反复处理密集的未来帧token。先前的方法通过token剪枝来解决这一问题，其优先考虑视觉保真度以降低视频扩散模型的去噪成本。然而，这些方法并未利用动作相关性来决定在WAM联合去噪过程中应保留哪些未来帧token。在本文中，我们提出了Sparse-WAM，这是一个无需训练的动作引导稀疏想象框架，通过选择性地处理未来帧token来加速WAM的推理。我们观察到，尽管未来表示在不断更新，但在相邻去噪步骤之间，从动作token到未来帧token的注意力（动作到未来注意力）的空间分布存在大量重叠。
tldr: 提出无需训练的Sparse-WAM框架，利用动作到未来注意力在相邻去噪步骤间的空间分布高度重叠这一特性，通过动作引导的稀疏想象选择性处理未来帧token，从而显著加速世界动作模型的推理。
en_tdlr: Sparse-WAM is a training-free framework that accelerates world action model inference by selectively processing future-frame tokens through action-guided sparse imagination, exploiting the substantial overlap in action-to-future attention distributions across consecutive denoising steps.
